definitions.english: Interest is extra money you get when you keep money in a bank.
definitions.sesotho: Phaello ke chelete e eketsehileng eo o e fumanang ha o boloka chelete bankeng.

definitions.english: When you save, the bank gives you a little extra money. That is interest.
definitions.sesotho: Ha o boloka, banka e o fa chelete e nyane e eketsehileng. Ke phaello.

definitions.english: Interest is like a reward for saving your money.
definitions.sesotho: Phaello e tshwana le moputso wa ho boloka chelete ya hao.

definitions.english: If you put M100 in the bank and get M5 extra, that M5 is interest.
definitions.sesotho: Haeba o kenya M100 bankeng mme o fumana M5 e eketsehileng, M5 eo ke phaello.

definitions.english: Interest is money that grows on your saved money.
definitions.sesotho: Phaello ke chelete e holang hodima chelete e bolokilweng.

definitions.english: Interest is the cost of borrowing or the reward for saving.
definitions.sesotho: Phaello ke theko ya ho alima kapa moputso wa ho boloka.

definitions.english: Interest is money paid for the use of borrowed money.
definitions.sesotho: Phaello ke chelete e lefuwang bakeng sa tshebediso ya chelete e alimilweng.

definitions.english: Simple interest is calculated on principal only. Compound interest includes accumulated interest.
definitions.sesotho: Phaello e bonolo e balwa hodima chelete feela. Phaello e kopaneng e kenyelletsa phaello e bokelletsweng.

definitions.english: Interest rate is expressed as a percentage.
definitions.sesotho: Phaello e hlaloswa e le peresente.

definitions.english: When you save, interest works for you. When you borrow, it works against you.
definitions.sesotho: Ha o boloka, phaello e o sebeletsa. Ha o alima, e o lwantsha.

definitions.english: Interest represents the time value of money.
definitions.sesotho: Phaello e emela boleng ba nako ba chelete.

definitions.english: Simple interest: I = P x r x t. Compound interest: A = P(1+r)^n.
definitions.sesotho: Phaello e bonolo: I = P x r x t. Phaello e kopaneng: A = P(1+r)^n.

definitions.english: Real interest rate equals nominal rate minus inflation.
definitions.sesotho: Phaello ya nnete e lekana le phaello ya lebitso ho tlosa inflation.

definitions.english: Central bank policy and inflation influence interest rates.
definitions.sesotho: Leano la banka e kgolo le inflation di ama phaello.

definitions.english: Effective annual rate accounts for compounding frequency.
definitions.sesotho: Phaello e sebetsang ea selemo e balela makgetlo a ho kopanya.

examples.english: Save M100 at 5 percent. After one year, you have M105.
examples.sesotho: Boloka M100 ka 5%. Kamora selemo, o na le M105.

examples.english: Borrow M50 and repay M55. The extra M5 is interest.
examples.sesotho: Alima M50 mme o kgutlise M55. M5 e eketsehileng ke phaello.

examples.english: A bank account gives interest, but a piggy bank does not.
examples.sesotho: Akhaonto ya banka e fana ka phaello, empa piggy bank ha e fane.

examples.english: Save M200 and get M10 extra. That is your interest.
examples.sesotho: Boloka M200 mme o fumane M10 e eketsehileng. Ke phaello ya hao.

examples.english: Interest makes your money grow while you sleep.
examples.sesotho: Phaello e etsa hore chelete ya hao e hole ha o robetse.

examples.english: M1,000 at 10 percent = repay M1,100 after one year.
examples.sesotho: M1,000 ka 10% = kgutlisa M1,100 kamora selemo.

examples.english: Simple interest on M5,000 at 8 percent for 3 years = M1,200.
examples.sesotho: Phaello e bonolo ho M5,000 ka 8% dilemo tse 3 = M1,200.

examples.english: Compound: M1,000 at 10 percent — Year 1: M1,100, Year 2: M1,210, Year 3: M1,331.
examples.sesotho: E kopaneng: M1,000 ka 10% — Selemo 1: M1,100, Selemo 2: M1,210, Selemo 3: M1,331.

examples.english: Save M100 monthly at 6 percent for 10 years = M16,470.
examples.sesotho: Boloka M100 ka kgwedi ka 6% dilemo tse 10 = M16,470.

examples.english: Credit card at 24 percent doubles debt every 3 years.
examples.sesotho: Karete ya mokitlane ka 24% e imena sekoloto ka dilemo tse 3.

examples.english: M10,000 at 7 percent for 10 years grows to M19,672.
examples.sesotho: M10,000 ka 7% dilemo tse 10 e hola ho fihlela M19,672.

examples.english: Rule of 72: divide 72 by rate to estimate doubling time.
examples.sesotho: Molao wa 72: arola 72 ka phaello ho hakanya nako ya ho imena.

examples.english: 12 percent monthly compounding = 12.68 percent effective annual.
examples.sesotho: 12% e kopanwang kgwedi le kgwedi = 12.68% e sebetsang ka selemo.

examples.english: M15,000 loan at 10 percent over 3 years = M4,500 interest.
examples.sesotho: Kalimo ya M15,000 ka 10% dilemo tse 3 = M4,500 phaello.

examples.english: At 6 percent inflation and 3 percent savings, real return is negative.
examples.sesotho: Ka inflation ya 6% le poloko ya 3%, phaello ya nnete e negative.

misconceptions.english: Interest is only for rich people — FALSE! Anyone earns interest on savings.
misconceptions.sesotho: Phaello ke ya barui feela — HA SE NNETE! Motho e mong le e mong o fumana phaello polokong.

misconceptions.english: All interest is bad — FALSE! Interest on savings is good!
misconceptions.sesotho: Phaello yohle e mpe — HA SE NNETE! Phaello polokong e ntle!

misconceptions.english: Interest grows money instantly — FALSE! It grows slowly over time.
misconceptions.sesotho: Phaello e holisa chelete hanghang — HA SE NNETE! E hola butle ka nako.

misconceptions.english: Interest only applies to loans — FALSE! Savings earn interest too.
misconceptions.sesotho: Phaello e sebetsa feela dikolong — HA SE NNETE! Poloko le yona e fumana phaello.

misconceptions.english: All banks offer same rates — FALSE! Rates vary significantly.
misconceptions.sesotho: Dibanka tsohle di fana ka diphaello tse tshwanang — HA SE NNETE! Di fapana haholo.

misconceptions.english: Compound equals simple interest — FALSE! Compound grows faster.
misconceptions.sesotho: E kopaneng e tshwana le e bonolo — HA SE NNETE! E kopaneng e hola ka potlako.

misconceptions.english: Low rates always help borrowers — FALSE! They hurt savers too.
misconceptions.sesotho: Diphaello tse tlase di thusa ba alimang — HA SE NNETE! Di utlwisa ba bolokang bohloko.

misconceptions.english: Rule of 72 is exact — FALSE! It is an approximation.
misconceptions.sesotho: Molao wa 72 o nepahetse — HA SE NNETE! Ke tekanyo feela.

misconceptions.english: Higher rates always mean better investments — FALSE! Risk matters.
misconceptions.sesotho: Diphaello tse phahameng di bolela matsete a matle — HA SE NNETE! Kotsi le yona e bohlokwa.

follow_up_suggestions.english: Want to learn how to calculate interest?
follow_up_suggestions.sesotho: Na o batla ho ithuta ho bala phaello?

follow_up_suggestions.english: Should we talk about compound interest?
follow_up_suggestions.sesotho: Na re bue ka phaello e kopaneng?

follow_up_suggestions.english: Want to know what interest rate to expect?
follow_up_suggestions.sesotho: Na o batla ho tseba phaello e lebeletsweng?
Na re bapise diakhaonto tsa poloko?
Na o batla ho utlwisisa phaello ya dikoloto?

how_to.english: Save money in a bank to earn interest.
how_to.sesotho: Boloka chelete bankeng ho fumana phaello.

how_to.english: Ask the bank about interest rates.
Leave your savings untouched to earn more.
how_to.sesotho: Tlohela poloko e sa amehe ho fumana phaello e ngata.

how_to.english: Compare interest rates from different banks.

how_to.sesotho: Utlwisisa phapang ya phaello e bonolo le e kopaneng.

how_to.english: Calculate interest using I = P x r x t.
how_to.sesotho: Bala phaello ka I = P x r x t.

how_to.english: Use compound interest formula A = P(1+r)^n.
Calculate effective annual rate for comparison.
Use Rule of 72 to estimate doubling time.

why.english: Interest is a reward for saving your money.
why.sesotho: Phaello ke moputso wa ho boloka.

why.english: Interest makes your money grow over time.
why.sesotho: Phaello e holisa chelete ka nako.

why.english: Saving in a bank is better than keeping money at home.
why.sesotho: Ho boloka bankeng ho molemo ho feta lapeng.
E kopaneng e potlakisa ho haha maruo.
Ho utlwisisa phaello ho thusa ho alima.

why.english: Interest rates affect savings and loans.
why.sesotho: Diphaello di ama poloko le dikoloto.

why.english: Interest represents the time value of money.
why.sesotho: Phaello e emela boleng ba nako.

why.english: Real interest rates account for inflation.
why.sesotho: Phaello ya nnete e balela inflation.

why.english: Interest knowledge is essential for investing.
why.sesotho: Tsebo ya phaello e bohlokwa matseteng.

situation.english: You save M100 at 5% interest. After one year, how much do you have?
situation.sesotho: O boloka M100 ka 5%. Kamora selemo, o na le bokae?

advice.english: M100 x 5% = M5 interest. Total = M105.
advice.sesotho: M100 x 5% = M5 phaello. Kakaretso = M105.

lesson.english: Interest is extra money on your savings.
lesson.sesotho: Phaello ke chelete e eketsehileng polokong.

situation.english: You borrow M1,000 at 10% annual interest for 2 years. What is the total repayment?
situation.sesotho: O alima M1,000 ka 10% ka selemo dilemo tse 2. Kakaretso ya tefo ke bokae?

advice.english: Interest = M1,000 x 10% x 2 = M200. Total = M1,200.
advice.sesotho: Phaello = M1,000 x 10% x 2 = M200. Kakaretso = M1,200.

lesson.english: The longer you borrow, the more interest you pay.
lesson.sesotho: Ha o alima nako e telele, o lefa phaello e ngata.

situation.english: You have M5,000 to save. Bank A offers 5% simple interest. Bank B offers 4.8% compound interest. Which is better after 5 years?
situation.sesotho: O na le M5,000 ho boloka. Banka A e fana ka 5% simple. Banka B e fana ka 4.8% compound. E feng e betere kamora dilemo tse 5?

advice.sesotho: Banka A: M6,250. Banka B: M6,317. Banka B e betere.

lesson.english: Compound interest beats simple interest over time.
lesson.sesotho: E kopaneng e feta e bonolo ka nako.
